CATEGORIZE YOUR TIME

Calendar event

Your choice takes priority over automatic suggestions. Category preferences are saved on this device for this Google account.

A fair count of your time

Today starts at midnight. This week starts on Monday. Only the elapsed part of a timed event counts toward “so far.”

Upcoming time appears under Scheduled. All-day entries and canceled events are excluded.

Duplicate calendar copies count once. If overlapping events have different categories, that interval goes into Overlapping time instead of inflating either category.

Uncategorized events remain in the total. Empty calendar space isn’t treated as work.

Category names in brackets, saved assignments, and your matching keywords help label events. You can always correct a suggestion.
